notes.title: Succubus Autumn Update
The Double Update for Succubus is here!
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

Succubus has VERY POSITIVE reviews and is doing well, but it does not mean that our work is over. We are improving and expanding the game just like we have promised in our 2021 Roadmap.

Initially we have planned two separate, free updates, but we decided to combine them into one and give you everything at once. So here it is, the Double Update for Succubus! 

Here are the new features, options and fixes:

- New eyes (customization)
- New horns (customization)
- New bodypaintings - scarifications (customization)
- New ranked arenas
- Option to choose an alternate censorship mode (without medkits and pixelization)
- Postprocess effects from selfie mode can now be set in game too
- Bugfixes 

And here are the sound fixes:

- Fixed the issue with women voices
- Jugs are no longer emitting improper sounds
- Audio balance tweaks
- Fixed the issue with bridge sounds not playing
- Fixed the issue with gate sounds not playing
- Fixed the issue with Pull Power sounds not working properly

Enjoy!
Madmind Studio

notes.title: SUCCUBUS Story Trailer and a new Release Date
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

We come to you with the new trailer and to explain why we have decided to postpone the game until October 5, 2021. The reason for postponing the release date is the need to fine-tune the game and bug fixing. To make sure that the you all get a bug-free and well-optimized production, we have decided to perform additional external tests and consulted the reviewers of well-known gaming services who completed the game and shared their thoughts and suggestions with us. We have decided to spend the extra time on introducing a few improvements that will give the players a better and more satisfying production.

You always say that we need to take our time and that there is no rush and that is why we have decided to take our time. There is no sense in releasing an unpolished product and we respect you too much to do so.

But we are not leaving you empty-handed. Here is our newest STORY TRAILER:

[previewyoutube=Uf39MT85kyM;full][/previewyoutube]

The key story cutscenes are created by talented animators from Fusion FX and Realtime Warriors, who have made, among others, cutscenes for The Witcher 3 and animations for Cyberpunk 2077. We hope you enjoy it and we appreciate your patience.

Thank You,
Madmind Studio

notes.title: SUCCUBUS - NEW RELEASE DATE
notes.notes:
Hell(o),

We would like to inform you about the change of the release date of Succubus. Initially, the title was supposed to be released in July. However, we have decided to spend more time optimizing and refining the production.

Succubus will be released on PC on September 8, 2021. 

Thanks to the extensive feedback from players who had the opportunity to check the game during the Steam Next demo festival, we have decided to refine some elements of the game so that our title can meet the high expectations of you - our fans. We want to release a game with the quality of which we and the players will be satisfied, because you, the players are most important.

Succubus is getting more interest before its launch (based on Steam Wishlist) than our previous game Agony, which sold over 500,000 copies. We believe that the extra time we have decided to spend on fine-tuning the title will allow us to provide fans with a production that meets their expectations.

The Succubus demo from the beginning to the end of the festival was the most popular and most downloaded demo in the genre of horror games. We want to make it even better!

Please be patient, we are putting our hearts and souls into this project (plus Vydija is watching)!

Your humble servants,
Madmind Studio

notes.title: Agony UNRATED console version - official statement!
notes.notes:
Dear Console Players, 

We are aware that you are disappointed because you cannot play Agony UNRATED but, like we stated before, it is not possible to publish the digital uncensored version of our game on consoles.

You have also asked about the improvements that are a big part of Agony UNRATED. Replacing 3D models and textures, adding new functionalities and gameplay mechanics and adding new lighting, would require re-certification and the game would have to be re-sent to rating agencies. 

Creating UNRATED as a DLC is not possible.

We cannot even do it on Steam because it would mean disregarding rating agencies and changing the target group, which is illegal due to the fact that the owners of the basic Agony version have paid for the censored version and we simply cannot change the rating.

Therefore, the release of Agony UNRATED is possible only as a separate application, unrelated to age ratings.

The only possibility for Agony UNRATED to appear on consoles is to publish it as a physical version.

Few stores would decide to distribute such a game, therefore finding a publisher who would be interested in producing UNRATED for consoles is extremely complicated.

In order for us to have a chance to do so, we need to have a basis that will show the potential publisher that his investment will return and allow him to earn.

Let’s keep our fingers crossed for the positive reception of Agony UNRATED on Steam because the probability of the console version depends on its success.

A lot of us at Madmind own both Xbox One and PS4 and we would really love to have Agony UNRATED for consoles in our collection.  Therefore nothing is sealed yet and we will inform you if we know anything more.

Thank you for your continuous support and understanding,
Madmind Studio
